en: Color postcard showing a massive round stone barbican tower and adjacent fortification walls of a medieval castle. A person in a red shirt walks along the road in front of the structure. In the background is a hilly landscape with a TV tower, and on the right stands a multi‑story historic building with a tower and steep roof. The reverse side has multilingual printed captions describing the view and standard postcard layout for address and stamp.
